acceptance_criteria.statement: Business account CRUD is feature-gated behind `b2b_enabled` and enforces owner-is-CUSTOMER, account locations, and OWNER or MANAGER membership roles with tenant isolation.
Tasks created on behalf of a business account persist `business_account_id`, reuse the standard task and booking flow, and can be listed at the account scope for authorized members.
B2B-tagged tasks receive a configurable priority dispatch weight in ranking without creating a separate booking lifecycle or separate payout path.
